items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: He used to send John Kazmin nights that he had to work, you know, somewhere.

ctx.x: Well, he used to have banjos. Banjos. Banjos. Banjos, yeah.

You know, Georgie Boy could talk to you in the clarinet, you know? He'd talk to his hands and his clarinet. Really? Yeah. He used to like it in his voice? We used to play with Guy at the Willow Inn. I remember he used to send John Kazmin nights that he had to work, you know, somewhere. Yeah.
Who were some of the best banjo players when you were just coming up, when you were starting to learn? Or who did you like to hear?
